description: Registry of source documents for PermitGraph's real regulatory corpus. 'content_hash' is the sha256 of the corresponding extracted_text/<id>/sections.json file (our structured transcription), computed and recorded so any future edit to the transcription is detectable. It is NOT a hash of the original Gazette PDF bytes (see 'original_upload_status' per document).
